verdict.rationale: Sentry does have automations: alert rules that send notifications, create tickets or call webhooks, plus Seer Autofix. So versioning, reviewing and rolling back those automations is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never documents version history, change review, or rollback for alert rules or other automations. Seer's code review covers GitHub/GitLab code changes, not automation definitions, so it does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
